scripts.dev:studio: pnpm exec cross-env NEXT_PUBLIC_ENABLE_STUDIO_MODE=true pnpm dev
scripts.dev:client: pnpm exec cross-env NEXT_PUBLIC_ENABLE_STUDIO_MODE=false NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_MODE=configurator pnpm dev
scripts.dev:phase1: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names PKG-SHARED,PKG-CONFIG,PKG-STUDIO --prefix-colors cyan,magenta,blue "pnpm --config.verifyDepsBeforeRun=false --filter @mashedgames/shared watch" "pnpm --config.verifyDepsBeforeRun=false --filter @mashedgames/configurator-engine watch" "pnpm --config.verifyDepsBeforeRun=false --filter @mashedgames/studio-engine watch"
scripts.dev:phase2: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names DASH,ENGINE --prefix-colors green,yellow "pnpm --config.verifyDepsBeforeRun=false --filter dashboard dev" "pnpm --config.verifyDepsBeforeRun=false --filter game-engine dev"
scripts.dev:desktop:studio: pnpm exec cross-env NEXT_PUBLIC_ENABLE_STUDIO_MODE=true pnpm dev
scripts.build:packages: pnpm --config.verifyDepsBeforeRun=false --filter @mashedgames/shared build && pnpm --config.verifyDepsBeforeRun=false --filter @mashedgames/configurator-engine build && pnpm --config.verifyDepsBeforeRun=false --filter @mashedgames/studio-engine build
scripts.build:pipeline: pnpm run build:clean && pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run build:dashboard:standalone && pnpm run build:game-engine && pnpm run build:assets:sync && pnpm run build:desktop:package
